observation: Round 2 (mask_r_high 2.79 -> 2.85; oblique Hough 40 / gap 80; horizontal Hough 40; inter_radius 0.07) was the first change that moved anything on 2-4: proxy 0.6806 -> 0.6867, correspondence_f1@15 0.4194 -> 0.4287, sam_fill_rate 0.7452 -> 0.7489, depth NaN flat (0.1091), residual 1.7 cm, ring_count_error 0. Both coherence features moved in the same direction as the evidence features, so the gain is not cosmetic. The round-2 artifacts show what is still missing: detected_lines.png is structurally the same as the anchor - K oblique pairs are complete only in the dense scanner band and to the right of x~700 (upper K row x 720-960 / 1200-1440 / 1680-1920, lower K row x 480-720 / 960-1200 / 1440-1680 / 1920-2160), while ring 0 lower K has only a positive-slope line, ring 1 upper K has no oblique line at all (green 'assume' prompt at x~360 in initial_prompt_points.png), and ring 9 upper K has only a negative-slope line; horizontal joints are still ~20 short blue segments although faint dotted longitudinal joints run across the whole map at y~350, 690, 850, 1950, 2380, 2600, 2960. The binary outlier map in detected_lines.png is visibly thinner in the left third (x < 700) and at the right edge than in the scanner band (x~1200-1450): the joint recesses in the sparse columns leave too few outlier pixels for HoughLinesP even at the threshold/gap bounds. Detection knobs are therefore exhausted (oblique threshold and gap are already at their bounds, binary_threshold is dead on this scan, verticals are synthetic), and the only thing that has changed the outcome is how many joint/recess points survive stage 2. Two stage-2 controls remain untouched inside bounds: the upper radial gate still has 5 cm of headroom (2.85 -> 2.90, and round 2 showed no NaN or residual penalty from the first +6 cm), and the density/gradient filter (grad_threshold 0.2, z_step 0.001) has never been relaxed - in the sparse left third, recess points are locally even sparser than the surrounding lining and are the most likely to be flagged by a density-difference test.
rule: sam4tun_ontology remediation r_radial_gate_widen for stage_2_denoise.f_over_gate (continue widening r_outer toward the bound while retention/NaN stay healthy) and the inter_stage_dependency stage_2_denoise.f_over_gate -> stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed -> stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (r_relax_hough precondition: fix upstream evidence first; Hough is already at its permissive bounds). experiences.md section 9: a proxy increase where sam_fill_rate rises together with the evidence features is a trustworthy signal, so the round-2 direction should be extended rather than reverted. experiences section 7 tuning order: stages 1 (residual 1.7 cm, |corr| 0.9997) and 2/3 (NaN 0.109, no banding) remain validated, so band-selection knobs (stage 3 in the order) are the right level to act on; section 5: verticals are synthetic so line count == ring count is guaranteed and ring_count_error cannot move; section 4 warns geometry knobs are load-bearing for transfer, so the change is confined to the single-scan overlay and stays inside the family bounds.
failure_mode: stage_2_denoise.f_over_gate (upper radial gate plus density/gradient filter still discard the deepest recess points in the low-density columns), propagating to stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed (thin outlier map in the left third / right edge) and stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (ring 1 upper K assumed, rings 0 and 9 single-sided, sparse horizontal joints -> correspondence_f1@15 stuck near 0.43).
rationale: Extend the only lever that produced a real gain and add the one untouched stage-2 lever that targets the sparse columns directly. (1) denoising.mask_r_high 2.85 -> 2.90 (bound): another 5 cm of depth headroom above the lining surface (r ~2.775), so recess points 7-12 cm deep that were still clipped can reach enhance_outlier_points and thicken the joint lines in the outlier map and the SAM depth input; round 2 showed this direction improves both correspondence_f1@15 and sam_fill_rate with no NaN or residual cost. (2) denoising.grad_threshold 0.2 -> 0.25 (bound): relax the density-difference test so cells whose density drops relative to their neighbours are less readily removed - in the left third of the map the recess points are locally sparser than the already-sparse lining and are the first casualties of this filter; keeping them is what rings 0, 1 and 9 need for their oblique pairs and what the horizontal joints need to become continuous segments. z_step is left at 0.001 so the bin geometry is unchanged and the effect is attributable to the threshold alone. mask_r_low stays 2.32 (rails/floor side untouched, no under-gate risk from below). (3) Detection stays at the round-2 permissive settings so the extra joint evidence can be consumed: hough_threshold_oblique 40, maxLineGap_oblique 80, hough_threshold_horizontal 40; inter_radius stays 0.07; binary_threshold and hough_threshold_vertical are not touched (dead knobs on this scan); sam.y_bounds is not touched (map height ~3100 px, the lower bound of 3600 is outside the map). Risks: under-gating behind the lining (grout/bolt pockets, cable brackets) could raise depth_outlier_ratio and add spurious oblique/horizontal candidates; the [5,10] deg angle filter, merge_close_points and the K/AB distance-pattern gate bound the prompt-level impact, and ring count is pinned by the synthetic verticals. Expected: correspondence_f1@15 > 0.44, sam_fill_rate >= 0.749, det_fallback_ratio 0.1 -> 0.0 if ring 1 gets an oblique line, denoise_retained_ratio slightly up, NaN flat, ring_count_error 0. If the proxy falls below round 2, the selector should keep round 2 (mask_r_high 2.85) - grad_threshold would then be the suspect, not the radial gate.
